Vendored from `@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.12.15` (`dist/esm`, MIT, https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm).

Three changes. In `classes.js`, a caller-supplied `classWorkerURL` is passed to `new Worker()` as given instead of through `new URL(classWorkerURL, import.meta.url)`. Turbopack in Next 16.4+ fails the whole build on that dynamic URL. Mark never passes `classWorkerURL`, so behaviour is unchanged. In `worker.js`, the runtime `import(coreURL)` carries `webpackIgnore`/`turbopackIgnore` so the bundler leaves it to the browser, which is what it always did at runtime. `worker.js` also inlines `const.js` and `errors.js`: Turbopack emits the worker as a standalone static file, so relative imports in it would 404 in the browser. Drop this copy once upstream builds under Turbopack.
